People: Grete Meisel-Hess (author, Wikidata Q1546005), died 1922. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Meisel-Hess, Grete, 1879-1922") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Ueber den physiologischen Schwachsinn des Weibes, Halle a. d. S. : C. Marhold, 1904, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_-E4SAAAAYAAJ. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 84%, 78%, 74% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Grete Meisel-Hess, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
